criteria.criterion: Regular fixed and country players share exclusive playback ownership within the tested browser profile/device.
criteria.evidence: Chromium 154.0.8037.97 renders 'TypeError: Illegal invocation' for the candidate coordinator constructor (/tmp/dial004-coordinator-repro.html). In src/playback-coordinator.ts, constructor stores native setInterval as this.interval and calls this.interval(...) when channel exists. src/player.ts constructs the player/coordinator before app.connect(); both regular resources share this bundle. This browser runtime failure prevents normal player initialization, so ownership cannot be established. No ChatGPT two-thread audio observation is claimed.
criteria.method: Bundle the exact candidate PlaybackCoordinator source and construct it in headless Chromium with a channel and lock provider, using native browser timers. Trace regular player startup order.

criteria.criterion: Play in a second thread pauses the previous player before starting; simultaneous and canceled attempts cannot overlap or restart stale audio.
criteria.evidence: The coordinator constructor throws in actual Chromium before installPlayer returns or app.connect() executes. Thus Play cannot be reached when the channel is available. Prior accepted Review showed three local asynchronous regression repros passing, but those do not exercise native browser timer receiver behavior. No ChatGPT audible takeover test was possible here.
criteria.method: Trace the candidate startup dependency and check browser constructor execution before Play; compare accepted local regression records.

criteria.criterion: Either thread can request Pause of the active player and show acknowledged versus unconfirmed status honestly.
criteria.evidence: The same constructor exception occurs before remote Pause control initialization and before app.connect(). Actual acknowledged versus unconfirmed status in ChatGPT remains unobserved.

criteria.criterion: Missing APIs, unresponsive owners, rapid actions and close/remount recovery have bounded safe behavior.

The same unbound native timer pattern occurs in acquire, heartbeat, pauseRemote, and cleanup paths. Prior local simulated remount/rapid-action tests are recorded, but actual ChatGPT background and close/remount behavior remains unobserved.
criteria.method: Exercise candidate constructor in Chromium with available coordination APIs and inspect candidate timer call sites; retain limits of prior local regressions.

findings.location: src/playback-coordinator.ts constructor and timer call sites; src/player.ts startup
findings.problem: Browser Window timer functions are stored as object fields and invoked with PlaybackCoordinator as receiver. Chromium rejects these calls with TypeError: Illegal invocation. The constructor's stale ticker throws synchronously before app.connect().
findings.requested_change: Invoke browser timers with a valid Window/globalThis receiver or wrap them in arrow functions, preserving injected fake timers; cover actual browser startup and timer paths in a focused regression, then return through independent Review and Verify.
